name: @flutterwavebnw/checkout-runtime
description: Loader for the Flutterwave Checkout browser runtime: the drop-in (our checkout mounted in-context on the merchant's own page) and the inline card field (one framed input inside a checkout the merchant builds). No redirect, no card data on the merchant surface — both drive the same CheckoutSession over that session's client_secret. Fetches the runtime from the checkout origin; ships types, not payment code.
